recognize_zh: 這是手術中開腹的大體照片，腹腔內幾乎被一個巨大、表面光滑呈紫紅色並帶黃白色纖維沾黏的器官佔滿，將腸道推擠到一旁，符合骨髓外造血所致的巨脾（massive splenomegaly）。
features: Intraoperative photograph through an abdominal incision
Massively enlarged, elongated dark red-purple organ filling most of the operative field, consistent with spleen
Smooth, glistening capsule with patchy yellow-white fibrinous adhesions or capsular thickening
Displaced adjacent bowel loops at the upper left and liver edge at the upper right
No cut surface visible, so infarcts or parenchymal nodularity cannot be assessed
describe_en: Intraoperative gross photograph shows a massively enlarged spleen occupying most of the abdominal field and displacing bowel loops, with a smooth congested capsule and patchy yellow-white adhesions or capsular fibrosis. The cut surface is not shown, so infarcts cannot be evaluated. The gross appearance is nonspecific; the etiology requires histologic and clinical correlation. Findings are consistent with massive splenomegaly, as seen with extramedullary hematopoiesis in primary myelofibrosis (agnogenic myeloid metaplasia).

ddx.vs: CML can produce identical massive splenomegaly and is distinguished by BCR-ABL1 testing and a leukocytosis with basophilia rather than leukoerythroblastosis with teardrop cells.

ddx.dx: Splenic lymphoma (e.g., splenic marginal zone or hairy cell leukemia)
ddx.vs: Lymphomas are separated histologically by white or red pulp lymphoid infiltrates and flow cytometry rather than trilineage extramedullary hematopoiesis.
These also cause massive splenomegaly but show Leishman-Donovan bodies in macrophages or hemoglobinopathy findings rather than MPN-related marrow fibrosis.
